name: Cherry Street Gallery
hours: Mon Closed; Tue 11 AM–4 PM; Wed 11 AM–4 PM; Thu 11 AM–4 PM; Fri 11 AM–4 PM; Sat 11 AM–4 PM; Sun Closed

reviews.t: The 2 start review on here is for a different business! This is a wonderful art gallery, curated like a museum. Incredibly kind and knowledgable staff. Stop by and spend a few minutes in this beautiful gallery!
Don't buy the wooden belts. As they will break after two uses. Looks good and uses cheap nylon cords, cords will break. The shop woman is very grumpy. No refunds!
